# Which roles answer the size of content at each option?

Read this when your style plugin answers the size of a part that is content rather than a control, at one size option.

These roles answer the family option `size` for content. Each name carries the option (`xs` to `xl`) and the part it measures, such as an avatar or a figure step.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Only Arena's components read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.

| role | question | type | user scale | role default | `default` answers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--size-lg-avatar` | How wide is an avatar at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `{avatar.lg}` |
| `--size-lg-caption-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list rank and secondary line at the lg size? | dimension | scales | none | `{dz.text-sm}` |
| `--size-lg-face` | How wide is the face in a people-list row at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `{avatar.md}` |
| `--size-lg-figure-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list figure at the lg size? | dimension | scales | none | `{dz.text-md}` |
| `--size-lg-list-gap` | How far apart are people-list rows at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `{sp.3}` |
| `--size-lg-logo-mark` | How big is the logo mark at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `{logo.mark-lg}` |
| `--size-lg-logo-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets the logo wordmark at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `{logo.text-lg}` |
| `--size-lg-name-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list name at the lg size? | dimension | scales | none | `{dz.text-lg}` |
| `--size-lg-rank` | How wide is a people-list rank at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `32px` |
| `--size-lg-row-gap` | How far apart are the parts of a people-list row at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `{sp.4}` |
| `--size-lg-row-pad-x` | How much side padding does a people-list row have at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `{sp.3}` |
| `--size-lg-row-pad-y` | How much top and bottom padding does a people-list row have at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none | `12px` |
| `--size-md-avatar` | How wide is an avatar at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none | `{avatar.md}` |
| `--size-md-caption-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a people-list rank and secondary line at the md size? | dimension | scales | none | `{dz.text-xs}` |
